articleTitle: The Brillouin Backscattering modeling for analysis of distributed irregularities in optical fibers
publicationTitle: 2010 10th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering APEIE-2010
abstract: The model operations results of the Brillouin Backscattering effect on the distributed irregularities in fiber-optical communication links are given in this paper.

articleTitle: The modified Schiffman phase shifter
publicationTitle: 2010 10th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering APEIE-2010
abstract: This paper presents the modified 90-degree Schiffman phase shifter (phaser). The new phaser is based on the reentrant structure with unequal dielectric constants of the interior and exterior microstrip substrates. The general TEM circuit model for the proposed phaser in terms of a series connection of the two-ports is presented and then used to determine its electrical parameters. As a result, the modified Schiffman phaser (SP) has a good performance over almost octave frequency range and compact multilayer architecture, showing promising potential for a variety of applications.

articleTitle: A modified broad-band planar quasi-Yagi antenna
publicationTitle: 2010 10th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering APEIE-2010
abstract: In this letter, a modified broad-band microstrip-fed planar antenna based on the classic Yaqi-Uda assembly is presented. This antenna has been developed using well known design tables. The (-10) dB return loss bandwidth of the antenna is 29 % for one director only. Incorporating additional directors has the potential for increasing the bandwidth. The antenna is realized on a thin dielectric substrate and is completely compatible with monolithic microstrip circuitry. This novel antenna should find wide application in wireless communication devices, phased arrays, as well as multi-beam systems.

articleTitle: The reentrant wideband bandpass/bandstop elliptic filters
publicationTitle: 2010 10th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering APEIE-2010
abstract: This paper presents a novel wideband bandpass/bandstop filter configuration. The new filter is based on the reentrant structure with unequal dielectric constants of the internal and external filling. As a result, additional symmetrical transmission zeros are generated at the lower and upper stop bands of the bandpass filter leading to elliptic function response that improves the pass band and selectivity. The same conclusions are formulated about the bandstop filter in terms of return loss. The general TEM circuit models for the proposed filters in terms of a series connection of the two-ports are presented and then used to determine its electrical parameters. An experimental prototype has been fabricated using conventional printed circuit board technology. Measured S-parameters show acceptable agreement with analytical and full-wave simulations, showing promising potential for a variety of applications.

articleTitle: Estimation of nonlinear effects in the optical fiber
publicationTitle: 2010 10th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering APEIE-2010
abstract: Nonlinear effects in optical fibers: nonlinearity of refraction index, a phase self-modulation and a phase cross-modulation, a four-waves merging, a stimulated Mandelshtam-Brillouin scattering and a Raman scattering are observed in this paper. The special attention is given to the physical side of the phenomena.

articleTitle: True zero-emission vehicle energy generation and measurement in students' educational project
publicationTitle: 2010 10th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering APEIE-2010
abstract: Up-to-date education shall prepare students for work in industry in an optimal and efficient way. Through the project described students are taught basics of renewable energy problems, details of electric vehicles and their power supply and power train, several types of high-efficiency power conversion methods, system design and circuit layout, all with practical realization and actual test. Going through all phases between first design and final composition and evaluation students get a real knowledge of processes of actual work. The project balances introduction into theory, basic circuits and adapted and improved versions, work of students in a self-responsible way, their learning from errors, and finally yielding a nice result creating high motivation for further work on the topics covered: Students may really drive the electric vehicle on the road they work on during the project.

articleTitle: Measuring converter of heart rate parameters
publicationTitle: 2010 10th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering APEIE-2010
abstract: The article deals with two-channel measuring converter of heart rate parameters, which implements the joint registration and signal processing of heart bioelectrical activity and distal arterial pulse. Analysis of uncertainties in determining parameters of heart rate was evaluated. A comparison of two methods for detecting systolic peak of distal arterial pulse wave was considered.

articleTitle: Innovative converters for the new electric equipment of electric locomotives and traction substations of railways
publicationTitle: 2010 10th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering APEIE-2010
abstract: For the railways electrified on a direct current, are offered new AC-DC converters with voltage 12–24kV in a contact network and new transformerless DC-DC converters with adjustable 0–3kV DC voltage for electric locomotives. articleTitle: Distributed fiber optical sensors on a principle of stimulated Brillouin scattering
publicationTitle: 2010 10th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering APEIE-2010
abstract: The report is dedicated to the analysis of distributed fiber optical sensors based on a phenomenon of stimulated Brillouin scattering. They have attracted large attention of research due to their capacity to measure temperatures and strains along large distances with a high accuracy and spatial resolution.

articleTitle: Linear multiuser detection study in DS-CDMA system in AWGN channel
publicationTitle: 2010 10th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering APEIE-2010
abstract: Direct sequence code division multiple access has been very successfully used by the military for decades and now is the most popular wireless technology. This paper presents comparative study between linear multiuser detectors, and conventional single user matched filter in DS-CDMA system. Analysis and simulations are conducted in synchronous AWGN channel, and Gold sequence is used as the spreading codes. The study shows that linear multiuser detectors perform better than the conventional matched filter in terms of BER performance. Although, MMSE detector provides better error performance than the decorrelating detector, the performance of all degrade as number of users increase.

articleTitle: On strong field nonlinear effect in semiconductor lasers
publicationTitle: 2010 10th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering APEIE-2010
abstract: A new strong field nonlinear effect in semiconductor lasers is described. This effect follows from the increase of the effective width of forbidden band Ē<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">g</inf> from the amplitude of electric field E, which necessitates the introduction of effective stimulated transition function D(Ẹ,Ꮗ), strongly dependent on E. It is shown that the gain g(E) which is proportional to D(Ẹ,Ꮗ) has a stepped dependence upon the threshold amplitude of electric field. The expression for D(Ẹ,Ꮗ) may be useful for the output power calculation and for the explanation of one-mode output power restriction.

abstract: Calculation of the number of existing modes in an industrial MW installation is presented. We consider a resonator of the rectangular shape and give an example of the resonator design method providing the maximum number of modes.

articleTitle: Some aspects of novel micro-contacts in Microwave Chip Carriers
publicationTitle: 2010 10th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering APEIE-2010
abstract: Design and development of novel type micro-contacts in Microwave Chip Carriers to Printed Circuit Board (PCB) assembly are presented in this paper. A new concept of micro-contacts for packaging solutions of microwave and mm-wave MMICs is depicted. Simulation and Vector Network Analyzer (VNA) measurement results for these micro-contact transitions are discussed. The results show that electrical parameters are highly dependent on the transition dimensions and substrate features. These contacts are based on male stud (bump) and female (ring) approach. When mating each other, clips effect and self-alignment features appear. Special attention is paid to the shape of the micro-contacts in order to facilitate assembly and strengthen the connection. Equivalent electrical circuit is proposed for SPICE simulation of the DC contact resistance. Finally, the article discusses technological development of the proposed new micro-contact stud/ring pair by means of low cost Ultra-violet electroplating, lithography and molding (UV-LIGA) process.

articleTitle: Tasks and methods of signal processing in seismic guard systems
publicationTitle: 2010 10th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering APEIE-2010

articleTitle: Study of microwave electromagnetic radiation in multilayer QFN package
publicationTitle: 2010 10th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering APEIE-2010
abstract: Electromagnetic radiation from parallel-plate planes of power-return and ground pairs are investigated. Such structures are widely used in microwave multilayer packages and could be the source of considerable electromagnetic interference (EMI) or simultaneously switching noise (SSI). Effective methods should be applied for damping and elimination of the radiated fields, especially in small areas and volumes. The developed threelayered LTCC microwave package possesses two separate grounding planes on different levels, connected through multiple vias. Estimation of the electromagnetic field distribution and radiation pattern is conducted by full-wave analysis. The article discusses the influence of the vias grid layout on the performance of an exemplary multi-port structure in the frequency band of interest - 10 to 30 GHz.

articleTitle: Invariant method of information transmission in fiber-optic transmission systems
publicationTitle: 2010 10th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering APEIE-2010
abstract: Synthesized method of controlling the distortions introduced by fiber-optic communications line. The method is based on the use of invariant equality. The main technical characteristics were determined.

articleTitle: The influence of width of mesa-piezoresistors on their characteristics
publicationTitle: 2010 10th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering APEIE-2010
abstract: The influence of width of polysilicon mesa-piezoresistors with dielectric insulation on their surface resistivity and piezosensitivity is studied experimentally when forming the passivating layer of thermal silicon oxide. It is demonstrated that the surface resistivity strongly increases when decreasing the width of mesa-piezoresistors in the interval of 3 ≤ W ≤ 10 μm. This fact concerns the decrease of the cross section and the impurity segregation during oxidation. It is found out that decrease of the width results in the increase of the longitudinal piezosensitivity and the decrease of the transverse one. For the concentration in question the temperature resistance coefficient of polysilicon resistors doped with boron decreases slightly with the decrease of width, and it remains constant if the dopant is phosphor. Simple model explaining the behavior of the surface resistivity and piezosensitivity is proposed in the paper.

articleTitle: The dipole radiating integrated device with modified via-free balun
publicationTitle: 2010 10th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering APEIE-2010
abstract: A novel variation of the conventional printed dipole antenna in combination with a modified microstrip via-free balun structure is proposed and named as the radiating integrated device (RID). By properly choosing their parameters, it is possible to create versions of the antenna that have suitable range of input voltage standing-wave ratio (VSWR) performance and radiation patterns. Prototype of this RID has been successfully implemented on a FAF-4 Russian printed-circuit-board substrate. Measured results of the 2.53 GHz RID have been compared with simulations and found to be in good agreement. The proposed antenna with the via-free balun, relatively low profile, and high polarization purity is very suitable candidate for mobile communication systems with single linear, dual linear or circular polarization.

articleTitle: Solution of «Amplitude, Phase, Frequency» problem in radioelectronics on the basis of application of fast inverse Laplace transformation
publicationTitle: 2010 10th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering APEIE-2010
abstract: There is a problem of ≪Amplitude, Phase, Frequency≫ (APF) in radiotechnics. Absence of solution to this problem caused a kind of arbitrariness in selection of envelope and phase of radiofrequency signal. As mentioned parameters are of informative importance for correct construction of contemporary radioelectronic facilities, characterized by high speed of data transfer, arbitrariness in selection of these parameters is inacceptable. On the basis of fastnverse Laplace transformation of this important for radioelectronics APF problem was solved, providing decisive definition of envelope and phase of radiofrequency signal that correspond to their physical meaning.
